name: hild
description: A woman in her forties, a stonemason. A strong, blunt, dry voice, full of opinions, medium pitch.
reference_text: Whoever built this wall should be ashamed of themselves. Look at it! Not one stone sits true. You want it to stand through a winter? Then you set the big ones at the bottom, you fill the gaps, and you never, ever hurry. Hand me the level. Thank you.
